Hey, it's Rachel. Sorry for the voice note, I know it's late for you. So, quick update on my week. I'm still working from the apartment, because they're painting the whole office, so these days I start around eight and I finish really late. It's snowing again here, which everybody complains about, but honestly I love it. On Saturdays I usually play tennis with my sister in Brooklyn, indoors of course, and then we go to that Peruvian place you told me about. Call me when you wake up. I want to hear everything about your week.

Hi Ana, it's Chris from the New York office. Thanks for sending the deck over. Quick update on my side: the team is finishing the visuals this week, and I'm putting the numbers together, so we are almost there. We normally present on a Thursday, but the client is traveling, so the pitch happens on Monday morning instead, nine o'clock your time. One more thing. They are pretty picky about the colors, so keep the palette simple and we avoid a long conversation about it. Talk soon.
